info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Workbench API
info.description: The Customer Workbench API facilitates seamless management of customer interactions across multiple channels. This endpoint allows businesses to enhance their customer service operations by creating and updating customer workbench entries. It supports various use cases, such as integrating customer data from different sources and managing requests efficiently. Ideal for customer service teams, marketing professionals, and sales representatives, this API aids in delivering a unified customer experience.

post.summary: Create a new customer workbench in the cross-channel platform.
post.description: This endpoint allows for the creation of a new customer workbench, enabling users to manage and analyze customer data across multiple channels efficiently. It is designed for use by businesses seeking to enhance their customer engagement strategies.
